subject.title: fix(hooks): wire message:sending internal hook to user-defined hooks

question: Should HOOK.md/internal hooks gain a new observational `message:sending` contract, and if so is colon-style naming the sole canonical key or must underscore compatibility be supported?
rationale: This creates a user-facing hook event and compatibility contract whose naming, ordering, and non-blocking semantics should be intentional before implementation is finalized.

options.title: Canonical observer event
options.body: Add colon-style `message:sending` as a post-policy, fire-and-forget observation event and direct filtering or cancellation users to typed plugin hooks.

options.title: Support a legacy alias
options.body: Also support `message_sending`, but document the compatibility contract and normalize registration so one handler cannot execute twice.

options.title: Typed hooks only
options.body: Do not add an internal pre-send event and close the linked request with guidance to use a native plugin and `api.on("message_sending", ...)`.

recommendation.title: Canonical observer event
recommendation.body: Add colon-style `message:sending` as a post-policy, fire-and-forget observation event and direct filtering or cancellation users to typed plugin hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent exact-once hook-delivery work covers the same ordering, channel, and policy boundaries.
